entities.name: NID
entities.description: Network identifier for SNPN networks, included when the 5G-GUTI was assigned by a different SNPN than the current registration target.

entities.name: 5GS mobile identity
entities.description: Contains the 5G-GUTI and other identity information for the UE.

entities.name: 5G-GUTI assigned by different SNPN
entities.description: Condition where the 5G-GUTI in the 5GS mobile identity IE was assigned by an SNPN other than the SNPN with which the UE is currently registering.

relations.description: The 5GS mobile identity IE may contain the NID IE under specific conditions.
Inclusion of the NID IE is conditional upon the 5G-GUTI being assigned by a different SNPN than the current registration target.
